# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_EXPANSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon (8,21,55) expands after a period of contraction, rising momentum increases the probability of a continuation breakout above the opening range. This edge exists because EMA ribbon expansion signals increasing trend strength, and breaking above the ORB confirms institutional participation, creating a favorable risk-reward setup for continuation.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Calculate 8,21,55 EMA on 5-min bars; ribbon_width = 55EMA - 8EMA. Enter long at bar close when:  
(1) ribbon_width > 1.5 * ATR(14),  
(2) ribbon_width increased for two consecutive bars (width_n > width_n-1 > width_n-2),  
(3) price > opening_range_high (high of first 30-min bars),  
(4) volume > 1.5 * average_volume_20bars.  

**Exit:** Initial stop at opening_range_low (chart-stop). Take profit 1 at 2R (risk from entry to stop). Trail remainder with chandelier exit (3*ATR) or exit on close below 21EMA. Trade only between 09:45-12:00 ET when VIX < 25; avoid periods where ribbon_width contracts.
